analyst.text:
Market GREEN (VIX 15). The Nasdaq 100 hit a record high on megacap AI strength and lower oil prices; futures are up about 0.4%. The 10-year yield is still elevated at 5.27%.
ACCOUNT SETUP FIRST: the TFSA trades US stocks in CAD with a ~1.5% conversion fee on each buy and sell. Backtested with that fee, the weekly strategy loses money (-61%). With a USD account it makes +196% (top-5 hold rule). Hold off on new trades until Wealthsimple Plus / USD is set up.
SNOW (held): ~$339, +2.7% in USD (about flat in CAD). Rank #10 (warning). Analyst target ~$414; earnings Dec 2. Sell when the USD account is ready.
Ranking: DELL #1, MU #2 (climbing, was #8), AMD #3, CRWD #4, ALAB #5.
Today's catch-up list shows ALAB and DELL. Once you're in USD, MU (#2) is the better second buy than ALAB (#5). ALAB is still above Monday's limit.
